description: Miles & More miles, Points, Qualifying Points and HON Circle Points for flights operated and ticketed by LOT Polish Airlines (ticket number 080), by booking class. Within one European country and between European countries: fixed miles by class; international: distance x class factor (25% to 200%) with a minimum per class. I, J, N and X earn nothing. Points and Qualifying Points per flight by cabin, continental or intercontinental (Economy 20/60, Premium Economy 20/80, Business 40/200; HON Circle Points in Business only). Algeria, Egypt, Libya, Morocco and Tunisia count as Europe; set tc to EU or AS for Turkey, Cyprus, Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan and Russia. LOT flights booked through a Lufthansa Group channel earn by fare instead (calculate_lufthansa_miles). Give segs: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and the ISO country codes of its two airports. Takes no price. Uses cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Unofficial.

cls.description: Booking class. C = C (Business 200%); D = D (Business 200%); F = F (Business 150%); Z = Z (Business 150%); P = P (Premium Economy 160%); A = A (Premium Economy 150%); R = R (Premium Economy 100%); Y = Y (Economy 150%); B = B (Economy 150%); M = M (Economy 100%); E = E (Economy 100%); H = H (Economy 100%); K = K (Economy 100%); Q = Q (Economy 100%); G = G (Economy 50%); S = S (Economy 50%); T = T (Economy 50%); V = V (Economy 50%); L = L (Economy 25%); O = O (Economy 25%); U = U (Economy 25%); W = W (Economy 25%); I = I (earns nothing); J = J (earns nothing); N = N (earns nothing); X = X (earns nothing). The letter on your ticket. Business C, D, F, Z; Premium Economy P, A, R; the rest Economy. I, J, N and X earn nothing.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter for creditTo, when it differs from the class question. Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of LOT Polish Airlines's own: united = United MileagePlus (creditStatus one of: General member, Premier Silver, Premier Gold, Premier Platinum, Premier 1K); aeroplan = Aeroplan (creditStatus one of: Aeroplan Member, 25K, 35K, 50K, 75K, Super Elite). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. The booking class is cls (or creditClass). The flights are segs (their miles), or creditFlights.

hp.description: HON Circle Points you have this year (optional). Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

pts.description: Points you have this year (optional). Used only for the progress toward the next tier.

qp.description: Qualifying Points you have this year (optional).

segs.description: The flights, one way and in order, one entry per flight (1 to 8): fromCountry and toCountry, the ISO 3166 two-letter country codes of its two airports; miles, its great-circle distance in miles (1 to 12,500); optional from and to, the IATA codes of its two airports, which label the breakdown; some airlines also use them (Vladivostok, VVO, on JAL and ANA; the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle, MAD-BCN, on Iberia; the long-haul tables named by city on SAS).

from.description: The departure airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

fromCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the departure airport, e.g. DE.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

toCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the arrival airport, e.g. DE.

status.description: Your Miles & More status. MM = Member (no status); FT = Frequent Traveller; SE = Senator; HC = HON Circle. Used for the progress toward the next tier. The bonus of up to 25% more miles for status holders is not published as a rule, so it is not added.

tc.description: Turkey, Cyprus, the Caucasus, Kazakhstan and Russia count as. EU = Europe; AS = Asia (outside Europe). These countries lie on two continents and Miles & More does not say which one it counts. Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

trip.description: Trip. ow = One way; rt = Round trip. Round trip counts the same flights back the other way.
